warning: Red: places the 2026 FWP regulations or FWP’s own lands layers close to hunting or to waterfowl hunting: Montana Statewide Closures (Warm Springs Pond 3, Helena Valley Regulating Reservoir, Lake Helena south half, Manhattan, Gates of the Mountains, Missouri River at Great Falls, McLean and Nelson reservoirs, Sands Lake, Yellowstone River in Treasure and Rosebud counties), Cochrane, Morony and Ryan reservoirs, Glacier and Yellowstone national parks, and FWP sites listed as NO HUNTING. Amber: special rules: Freezout WMA (closed Oct. 3 - Nov. 19), Canyon Ferry (hours end at noon Oct. 3-9) and the seven Indian reservations (state rules apply only on deeded land: check the tribe). MOST of the closures are given in the regulations by legal description, so the shapes are the named water body or a locator circle and are marked approximate. Not drawn: Block Management Area safety zones and no-shooting areas, the sandhill crane and swan permit areas, posted WMA winter closures, and temporary FWP site closures. Not being listed does NOT make a place open: look for posted signs.
source: Montana Fish, Wildlife & Parks 2026 Migratory Birds regulations (pp. 5-9, adopted by the Fish and Wildlife Commission April 17, 2026); FWP Wildlife Management Areas, Fishing Access Sites and State Parks layers; FWP reference dams; National Park Service land (BLM Surface Management Agency); Census TIGER reservations; USGS NHD and GNIS.

areas.n: Warm Springs Pond No. 3 (Deer Lodge County) - closed
areas.d: Listed under Statewide Closures in the 2026 FWP migratory bird regulations (p. 6), by a boundary running from the I-90 / Opportunity Road junction along the base of the Warm Springs Settling Pond No. 3 dike to I-90 (parts of Sections 1, 2, 11 and 12, T4N R10W; 30 and 31, T5N R9W; 25 and 36, T5N R10W). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. LOCATOR CIRCLE (2.5 km) around the Warm Springs Ponds (the mean of FWP reference-dam points for Warm Springs Tailing Dams #1-#3); it does not show which pond is No. 3 or its boundary. APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Helena Valley Regulating Reservoir - closed to all hunting from the waterfowl opener
areas.d: Lewis and Clark County, Bureau of Reclamation reservoir in Sections 4, 5, 8, 9, 16 and 17, T10N R2W, as posted. Open to hunting until the waterfowl season opens (Oct. 3), then closed to ALL hunting (2026 FWP regs p. 6). Outline: whole reservoir (USGS NHD). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Lake Helena, south half - closed to waterfowl and crane hunting
areas.d: South half of Lake Helena (Lewis and Clark County), parts of Sections 23-26, T11N R3W and Sections 19 and 30, T11N R2W: closed to hunting, harassment or molesting of migratory waterfowl and sandhill cranes, except the direct and immediate foot, boat or dog retrieval of downed game that fell in the closed area (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The legal line is marked by red buoys. Shape drawn: the part of the NHD lake outline south of its mid-latitude. APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Manhattan Game Closure, portion (Gallatin County) - closed
areas.d: Portion of the Manhattan Game Closure west of the West Gallatin River and south of I-90, described by the interstate, the Spring Creek irrigation canal, Perk Canal, Camp Creek and Spring Creek to the south line of Section 23, T1N R3E (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. LOCATOR CIRCLE (3.5 km) at Manhattan, not the boundary. APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Gates of the Mountains Game Preserve (Lewis and Clark County) - no hunting
areas.d: Region 3 and 4: no hunting. From the southeast corner of Upper Holter Lake along the lake’s north shore, Stoney Point Beacon Road, the powerline, Bulldozer Road and the ridge in Section 23, T13N R3W to the Missouri River, across it to the U.S. Forest Service wilderness boundary and back south to Upper Holter Lake (2026 FWP regs p. 6). LOCATOR CIRCLE (6 km) near Upper Holter Lake, not the boundary. APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Freezout WMA (Teton County) - closed to all hunting from the waterfowl opener to Nov. 19
areas.d: Open to upland game bird hunting until the waterfowl season opens (Oct. 3). From the opener through Nov. 19: no hunting, access or harassment of wildlife, except the direct and immediate foot, boat or dog retrieval of downed game that fell in the closed area. Reopens for all hunting Nov. 20 to the end of the season (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation lists SW 1/4 Section 19, Sections 29 and 30 (T22N R3W) and parts of Sections 12, 13 and 24 (T22N R4W) inside the posted boundary; the outline drawn is FWP’s whole Freezout WMA layer. Swan hunters at Freezout need a watercraft, a retrieving dog or chest-high waders for the dikes. APPROXIMATE (whole WMA outline).

areas.n: Missouri River, Great Falls (Cascade County) - closed
areas.d: The Missouri River below the ordinary high water, with all islands, backwaters and sandbars, from the mouth of Sand Coulee Creek (Section 36, T20N R3E) downstream to Black Eagle Dam (Section 6, T20N R4E) (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. Shape drawn: the NHD river-area polygon in that reach (none found: a locator circle at mid-reach). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: McLean Reservoir (Hill County) - closed
areas.d: About 2,560 acres in Sections 16, 17, 20 and 21, T36N R15E (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. Outline: whole reservoir (USGS NHD). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Nelson Reservoir (Phillips County) - closed (reservoir and 300 yards of shoreline)
areas.d: All of the parts of Nelson Reservoir and within 300 yards of its shoreline in the sections listed in T32N R32E, T32N R31E, T31N R31E and T31N R32E (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. Outline: whole reservoir (USGS NHD), WITHOUT the 300-yard shoreline strip. APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Sands Lake (Hill County) - closed
areas.d: SW 1/4 of Section 18, T32N R16E (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. Outline: whole lake (USGS NHD). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Yellowstone River, Treasure and Rosebud counties - closed
areas.d: The Yellowstone River from the mouth of the Bighorn River east to the Rosebud-Custer county line east of Hathaway, within the normal stream flow and including all islands, backwaters and sandbars, as posted (2026 FWP regs p. 6). The regulation text does not say which species: treat as closed to hunting. Shape drawn: NHD river-area polygons in Treasure and Rosebud counties. APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Cochrane Reservoir (Cascade County) - closed to waterfowl hunting
areas.d: Pacific Flyway Exception 2: Cochrane, Morony and Ryan reservoirs in Cascade County are closed to waterfowl hunting (2026 FWP regs p. 9). Shape drawn: the NHD water polygon within 3 km of Cochrane Dam (the Missouri River reservoir above it). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Ryan Reservoir (Cascade County) - closed to waterfowl hunting
areas.d: Pacific Flyway Exception 2: Cochrane, Morony and Ryan reservoirs in Cascade County are closed to waterfowl hunting (2026 FWP regs p. 9). Shape drawn: the NHD water polygon within 3 km of Ryan Dam (the Missouri River reservoir above it). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Morony Reservoir (Cascade County) - closed to waterfowl hunting
areas.d: Pacific Flyway Exception 2: Cochrane, Morony and Ryan reservoirs in Cascade County are closed to waterfowl hunting (2026 FWP regs p. 9). Shape drawn: a LOCATOR CIRCLE (1.5 km) at Morony Dam (FWP reference-dam point). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Canyon Ferry - shooting hours end at noon Oct. 3-9 and Sept. 26-27
areas.d: Pacific Flyway Exception 1: at Canyon Ferry (parts of Broadwater, Lewis and Clark and Jefferson counties, described by State Route 284, US 287, US 12, the Jefferson-Broadwater and Broadwater-Meagher county lines and Magpie Gulch) hunting hours for all ducks, geese, mergansers and coots are one-half hour before sunrise to NOON on Oct. 3-9, 2026 and on the special youth days Sept. 26-27; from Oct. 10 regular hours apply (2026 FWP regs p. 2, 7, 9). Canyon Ferry WMA ponds 2, 3 and 4 gates open at noon the day before the youth and general seasons (p. 5). Shape drawn: the Canyon Ferry Lake outline (USGS NHD). APPROXIMATE: the regulation gives this area by legal description (township / range / section) or by roads, which no public layer carries; the shape drawn is the named water body or a locator circle, not the legal boundary.

areas.n: Yellowstone National Park (Montana part) - closed to hunting
areas.d: National parks are closed to hunting (2026 FWP regs p. 5). Outline: National Park Service surface-management polygon (BLM Surface Management Agency layer), generalised to about 30 m. Other National Park Service units (e.g. Bighorn Canyon National Recreation Area) have their own rules and are not drawn.

areas.n: Glacier National Park - closed to hunting
areas.d: National parks are closed to hunting (2026 FWP regs p. 5). Outline: National Park Service surface-management polygon (BLM Surface Management Agency layer), generalised to about 30 m. Other National Park Service units (e.g. Bighorn Canyon National Recreation Area) have their own rules and are not drawn.
